arguments.command:
cd /work/ProbabilityTheoryFormalization && perl -0pi -e 's/change Tendsto \(fun x => ProbabilityTheory\.cdf \(μ : Measure ℝ\) x\) atBot \(𝓝 0\)
  exact ProbabilityTheory\.tendsto_cdf_atBot \(μ : Measure ℝ\)/simpa only [measureCdf, ProbabilityTheory.cdf_eq_real] using
    ProbabilityTheory.tendsto_cdf_atBot (μ : Measure ℝ)/; s/change Tendsto \(fun x => ProbabilityTheory\.cdf \(μ : Measure ℝ\) x\) atTop \(𝓝 1\)
  exact ProbabilityTheory\.tendsto_cdf_atTop \(μ : Measure ℝ\)/simpa only [measureCdf, ProbabilityTheory.cdf_eq_real] using
    ProbabilityTheory.tendsto_cdf_atTop (μ : Measure ℝ)/; s/change Monotone \(fun x => ProbabilityTheory\.cdf \(μ : Measure ℝ\) x\)
  exact ProbabilityTheory\.monotone_cdf \(μ : Measure ℝ\)/simpa only [measureCdf, ProbabilityTheory.cdf_eq_real] using
    ProbabilityTheory.monotone_cdf (μ : Measure ℝ)/; s/change ContinuousWithinAt \(fun y => ProbabilityTheory\.cdf \(μ : Measure ℝ\) y\) \(Ici x\) x
  exact \(ProbabilityTheory\.cdf \(μ : Measure ℝ\)\)\.right_continuous x/simpa only [measureCdf, ProbabilityTheory.cdf_eq_real] using
    (ProbabilityTheory.cdf (μ : Measure ℝ)).right_continuous x/; s/\(lt_trans ha hx\)/(lt_trans hx ha)/; s/exact \(not_lt_of_ge \(\(monotone μ\) hxy\)\) \(lt_of_le_of_lt hux hyS\)/exact (not_lt_of_ge (hux.trans ((monotone μ) hxy))) hyS/; s/    apply le_csSup \(lowerSet_bddAbove μ hv\.2\)
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt \(\(quantile_le_iff μ hu\.1 hu\.2\)\.1 le_rfl\) huv_strict/    refine csSup_le (lowerSet_nonempty μ hu.1) ?_
    intro y hy
    change measureCdf μ y < u at hy
    exact le_csSup (lowerSet_bddAbove μ hv.2) (lt_trans hy huv_strict)/' ProbabilityTheory/chapter_10/thm_10_8_support.lean
PATH=/opt/lean/bin:$PATH lake env lean ProbabilityTheory/chapter_10/thm_10_8_support.lean
